cases.title: One hold on the demo target, in plain words, frames either side, Edit > Undo

rubric.reason: Turn 3 has one key_types_demo call, on the 1–1.4 s pair. The reply names layer, property and time ("I held Blink's Opacity at 1 s, so it snaps at 1.4 s") and gives Edit > Undo. It describes both returned frames (just before 1.4 s fully visible, one frame later "jumps straight to 0 and vanishes"), which covers the Opacity-0 vanish. It ends with "The 1.4 s and 1.8 s pairs are yours; say done."

Turn 3 reports one change in plain words that match the tool result (out_type hold at 1 s on Blink's Opacity) and says "Edit > Undo reverses it". It uses no undo label or field names and hands the remaining pairs back without offering to do them.

Every name and time comes from tool output or follows from it: Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, Mentor Practice 2, the pairs at 1, 1.4 and 1.8 s, Cut at 3 s, and the frames around 1.4 s from the demo result. The fading at 1.2 s follows from the eased 100→0 pair.

Turn 3 holds only the 1 s pair (the demo result shows out_type hold for 1–1.4 s). It names the layer, property and times ('held Blink's Opacity key at 1 s… stays fully visible right up to 1.4 s and then jumps to 0') and covers both returned frames ('At 1.367 s… still fully visible. One frame later it's at 0'). It says 'it vanishes there', gives Edit > Undo, and hands back 'The pairs at 1.4 s and 1.8 s are yours to hold'.

Turn 3 describes one change in plain words with real names ('I held Blink's Opacity key at 1 s'). It says 'use **Edit > Undo**' with no undo label or field names such as in_type or out_type, and it hands the rest back without offering to do them.

Every name and time is backed by tool results: Blink and Cut Opacity at 1 s and 3 s, Seal as a precomp, Dot 1 jumping at 0.5 s, the 1/1.4/1.8 s pair starts, 100→0, and 1.367 s plus 'one frame later' (1.433 s) from the demo result.

In Turn 3 the mentor held only the 1 s pair ("I held Blink's Opacity key at 1 s"), showed the frame just before 1.4 s, said that at 1.4 s Opacity drops to 0 and Blink "vanishes", named Edit > Undo, and handed back the rest with "The 1.4 s and 1.8 s pairs are yours; say done."

Turn 3 describes one change in plain words with real names ("stays fully visible until 1.4 s and then snaps out"), says "use Edit > Undo" with no undo label or field names, and hands the remaining pairs to the learner without offering to do them.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions comes from the snapshot or demo results: Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, Opacity, and 1 s, 1.4 s and 1.8 s. The half see-through at 1.2 s and the drop to 0 at 1.4 s follow from the pair values 100→0 over 1–1.4 s at 30 fps.
